import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island case/space variants (e.g., 'torgersen' -> 'Torgersen', 'Dream ' -> 'Dream')
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (take absolute value, e.g., -215 -> 215)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
